theses.thesis: The theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.13) and breadth is extreme (0.929), suggesting very wide participation that historically marks late-stage rallies. In a mean‑reverting market where the trend gate failed, extended breadth and crowding elevate the risk of a shake‑out; better to avoid.
theses.dissent: Biotech/innovation policy tailwinds or a dovish PBoC stance could keep the trend intact; crowding alone has no forward fade edge and should not be treated as a sell.
